boundaries.name: rust-semantics
boundaries.obligation: The Lean model is handwritten; nothing proves it refines the Rust source, rustc lowering, integer wrapping, or panic behaviour.

boundaries.name: signature-validity
boundaries.obligation: Nothing here proves that an accepted encoding is a valid Falcon signature; the vendored tree contains no verifier and the relation s1 = c - s2*h is never checked in this model.

boundaries.name: serialization-traits
boundaries.obligation: ByteReader/ByteWriter/Deserializable semantics come from falcon_sig::compat; buffer bounds and read_array behaviour are assumed to match the modelled fixed-length reads.

boundaries.name: machine-integer-wrapping
boundaries.obligation: i16/u16/u32/u128 wrap-around, casts and shift semantics are modelled by Nat/Int operations chosen to match on the ranges reached; out-of-range behaviour is not covered.

boundaries.name: constant-time-behaviour
boundaries.obligation: No timing or side-channel property is modelled; the branchy decoders and the subtle::ConstantTimeEq comparison are treated as ordinary functions.
